courses.title: Research Planning for Product Teams
courses.description: Research Planning for Product Teams takes you from the basics of research planning to applying it on a realistic UX Researcher scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to qualitative data analysis, enough to use it alongside research planning day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying research planning to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing research planning through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to qualitative data analysis
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Research Synthesis
courses.description: Applying Research Synthesis goes beyond the basics of research synthesis, for people already working toward a UX Researcher role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in research synthesis and want to go further.

courses.title: Getting Started with Data Visualization
courses.description: Getting Started with Data Visualization walks you through the basics of data visualization, built for people new to UX Researcher work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of data visualization, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

courses.title: A Short Guide to Accessibility Testing
courses.description: A Short Guide to Accessibility Testing is a short introduction to accessibility testing for people moving toward a UX Researcher role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show accessibility testing in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if accessibility testing is new to you.

Practicing accessibility testing through guided exercises
Building a short accessibility testing exercise from scratch
